# Scout documentation illustration

Conceptual artwork identifying the integration, not a product screenshot or an endorsement.

The light and dark illustrations share the same geometry. Their platform mark is embedded, so the SVG needs no network requests or sibling image files. Each asset includes an accessible title and description.

## Mark provenance

- Scout: canonical outlined hexagon and filled center from the Scout brand kit.
- Claude Code: Claude asterisk from https://claude.com/favicon.svg; the existing Scout site asset, with original clay color.
- Codex: Codex app icon from the existing Scout site asset (`landing/openscout.app/public/harnesses/codex.svg`), whose provenance identifies the official ChatGPT desktop app as the source.
- Cursor: Cursor cube from https://cursor.com/brand; the existing Scout site SVG, with original geometry and tones.
- Grok Bot: The established Scout site Grok Bot face (`integration-logos/grok-bot.svg`), whose provenance records a redraw from https://x.ai/bot. The circle uses theme ink; its geometry and eye mask are preserved.

Platform marks and names remain the property of their respective owners. The original mark geometry is retained.

Shared source and regeneration: [oscout/.github illustrations](https://github.com/oscout/.github/tree/main/illustrations).
